articles.summary:
President has opposing views on many issues, and once called Leo’s predecessor the ‘representative of the Evil One’

Trees are being planted in the garden. The brightly coloured buildings are getting another coat of paint. The choir rehearses. Hundreds of other residents, several of them using wheelchairs, practise their positions outside the sanctuary. Excitement is in the air, because on Monday 9 November, the Cottolengo Don Orione – a Catholic-run home for disabled people – will be the first stop on Pope Leo XIV’s first full day of his trip to Argentina.

But the pope’s visit to Claypole, about 26km from Buenos Aires, does not come at an especially happy time for the home, which counts about 400 residents with disabilities. Argentina’s president, Javier Milei, has made wide-ranging cuts to disability funding.

articles.title: Banana producers in Latin America want better pay to cope with effects of climate crisis
articles.summary:
Farmers face big drop in production from extreme weather during this year’s super El Niño event

Banana producers in Latin America are calling for better pay to help cope with the impact of the climate crisis, as they face big drops in production resulting from extreme weather during this year’s super El Niño event.

High winds in parts of Colombia, one of the biggest suppliers to the UK market where droughts are predicted in some regions this year, and heavy rainfall in Peru and Ecuador are already affecting production, according to the Fairtrade Foundation ethical trade body. In the Dominican Republic, farmers are expected to face drought conditions, with forecasts of drier and warmer than usual conditions.

Venezuelské nálety na gerilu ELN navíc testují dosavadní regionální mocenské rovnováhy a měnové trhy reagují na politickou nestabilitu oslabením měn, jako je paraguayský guaraní.
archive.security_status_en: South America is gripped by severe political and security crises, including the impeachment of Paraguay's president over the Ueno Bank collapse and an escalation of violence in Colombia following drone attacks on a military base. Furthermore, Venezuelan airstrikes against the ELN guerrilla group are testing regional power dynamics, while currency markets react to political instability with steep drops like that of the Paraguayan guaraní.
archive.forecast_cs: V příštích dnech lze očekávat pokračující napětí a protesty v Paraguayi po sesazení prezidenta a zostřenou bezpečnostní situaci na kolumbijsko-venezeruských hranicích. Komoditní trhy, zejména káva a kovy, budou vykazovat zvýšenou volatilitu.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, ongoing tensions and protests are expected in Paraguay following the president's ouster, alongside heightened security concerns at the Colombia-Venezuela border. Commodity markets, particularly coffee and metals, will exhibit increased volatility.

archive.security_status_cs: Jižní Amerika čelí výrazné nestabilitě, již ilustruje sesazení a zatčení paraguayského prezidenta Santiaga Peňi kvůli bankovní krizi a eskalující násilí v jižním Kolumbijsku provázené útoky na vojenské základny. Venezuelské nálety proti gerilám ELN mezitím testují dlouhodobou toleranci režimu a zvyšují geopolitické napětí na hranicích.
archive.security_status_en: South America faces significant instability, illustrated by the ouster and arrest of Paraguayan President Santiago Peña amid a banking crisis and escalating violence in southern Colombia marked by attacks on military bases. Meanwhile, Venezuelan airstrikes against ELN guerrillas are testing the regime's long-term tolerance and raising cross-border geopolitical tensions.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující politické protesty a právní tahanice v Paraguayi po sesazení prezidenta, zatímco bezpečnostní situace na kolumbijsko-venezeruských hranicích zůstane napjatá.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, ongoing political protests and legal battles are expected in Paraguay following the president's ouster, while security along the Colombia-Venezuela border will remain tense.
